complete_proof_steps.details: Let J be the genuine increment joint tower and K the same sectorCoefficientTower at p. componentCoefficientScalarJet_of_mem gives the local scalar jet=K.D. J.pointTower_eq_jointJet then gives K.D=J.D with zero spatial directions. All functions are the literal coefficientFamily increment; unlike the original-coefficient variant, no reference term is added.

complete_proof_steps.stage: actual mixed bound on that J
complete_proof_steps.details: For fixed state and slots, obtain EqOn localScalarJet (fun q=>J.D n(x,q)(v,0)) on the open component from the previous identity. mixedDerivative_congr_on_open transfers the raw componentCoefficientScalarJet_mixed_bound without changing constants, H, sample, base, loss or derivative order. The public 2882 original-field proof has the same actual locality pattern; do not use its absorbed-height estimate.

For exponent R≥0, use materialSample_global_endpoint_models hT hN.1.1. Its actual endpoint coordinate x_j≥0 differs from cellIndex j by at most L, and E0(sample j)≤KE*materialE0(x_j). Apply materialE0_rpow_oneSided_shift hR hL with y=cellIndex j. Rewrite materialE0(y)^P=exp(P)*radialE(y)^P using radialE_rpow_eq_materialE0. Output K_R>0,P_R≥0 uniform in j with E0(sample j)^R≤K_R*W_j^P_R. Obtain sample E0/H positivity from materialSample_mem_radialCore and hT.2.1 as in MaterialSampleGlobalModels/Shift.

For fixed total n choose raw B_k>0 for k:Fin(n+1), with spatial cap n. Apply the previous helper at R=B_k. Put A=sum_k B_k*K_k and P=sum_k P_k. Since W_j≥1 and every P_k≥0, each B_k*E0(sample j)^B_k≤A*W_j^P. Never maximize E0 exponents before converting to W≥1.

For k+a+b≤n, use the mixed bound at k,cap n. multilinearTameSize_le_affine bounds oneHigh on parameter-unit slots. In jointJet_unit_bound_of_mixed_parameter_bounds choose C=h_j*A*W_j^P and affine H=1+p(n+loss)x. Product max-norm facts norm_fst_le/norm_snd_le convert p base(state)+norm(spatial)≤1 to its three unit conditions. Output coefficient 3^n*A and the intact h_j. This is the actual n-th joint jet, including n=0.

For h_j>0 use smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose_apply. Its n-th value is h_j^(-1) times the same J.D n. Real scalar norm/absolute-value identities and h_j^(-1)*h_j=1 cancel the factor exactly. Do not call UniformWeightedJointGrowth.postLinear with a label-dependent map or charge an estimate for h_j^(-1). The resulting constants are the same 3^n*A,P for every m.

exact_additional_public_heads.header:
theorem mixedDerivative_congr_on_open
    {U : Set PolarPoint} {f g : PolarPoint → ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hfg : EqOn f g U)
    (a b : ℕ) {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p ∈ U) :
    mixedDerivative a b f p = mixedDerivative a b g p

theorem multilinearTameSize_le_affine (low high : Seminorm ℝ E) (k : ℕ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : Fin k → E) (hv : ∀ i, low (v i) ≤ 1) :
    multilinearTameSize low high k a v ≤ a + ∑ i, high (v i)

theorem materialSample_global_endpoint_models
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hRef : IsAccumulatingProfile D) :
    ∃ d0 L KH KE KM : ℝ,
      0 < d0 ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ 1 ≤ KH ∧ 1 ≤ KE ∧ 1 ≤ KM ∧ ∀ m,
      let x := endpointX d0 (endpointDistance D (T.sample m))
      0 ≤ x ∧ |x - (D.cellIndex m : ℝ)| ≤ L ∧
        T.H (T.sample m) ≤ KH * materialH x ∧
        materialH x ≤ KH * T.H (T.sample m) ∧
        T.E0 (T.sample m) ≤ KE * materialE0 x ∧
        materialE0 x ≤ KE * T.E0 (T.sample m) ∧
        T.M (T.sample m) ≤ KM * materialM x ∧
        materialM x ≤ KM * T.M (T.sample m)

theorem materialE0_rpow_oneSided_shift
    {R L : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ K P : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ 0 ≤ P ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ,
      0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y → x ≤ y + L →
      materialE0 x ^ R ≤ K * materialE0 y ^ P

theorem radialE_rpow_eq_materialE0 (n : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    radialE n ^ A = Real.exp (-A) * materialE0 (n : ℝ) ^ A

theorem smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose_apply
    (J : SmoothDirections U f) (L : F →L[ℝ] G) (k : ℕ) (x : E) (v : Fin k → E) :
    (smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose J L).D k x v = L (J.D k x v)

exact_additional_public_heads.definition:
def UniformWeightedJointGrowth
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (W : I → ℝ)
    {U : Set E} {V : I → Set P} {f : I → E × P → F}
    (J : ∀ i, SmoothDirections (U ×ˢ V i) (f i)) (base loss : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ Q ∧
    ∀ i x, x ∈ U → p base x ≤ R → ∀ y ∈ V i, ∀ v : Fin n → E × P,
      (∀ j, p base (v j).1 + ‖(v j).2‖ ≤ 1) →
      ‖(J i).D n (x, y) v‖ ≤ C * W i ^ Q *
        (1 + p (n + loss) x + ∑ j : Fin n, p (n + loss) (v j).1)
